description: Official RealWorld Conduit backend: Medium-style articles, comments, tags, favorites and follows exposed as a JSON REST API with JWT auth.
RealWorld Conduit backend API built with NestJS and MikroORM (MySQL): users, profiles, articles, comments, tags and favorites.
TDD-built RealWorld Conduit API on NestJS + TypeORM + PostgreSQL with JWT/local Passport auth for articles, comments and profiles.
Koa + TypeScript REST API implementing the RealWorld Conduit spec (articles, comments, profiles) with TypeORM/PostgreSQL, Awilix DI and JWT auth.
NestJS + Prisma e-commerce API with users, products, categories, carts/purchases and admin-only product management including product picture uploads to local disk.
Production-style Express + MongoDB blogging backend with API keys, JWT access/refresh tokens, role-based writer/editor flows and Redis-cached blog listings.
NestJS + MongoDB backend for a content app of motivational mentors, topics, bookmarks and user-submitted content, with JWT auth, Redis caching and local file serving.
Next.js SaaS starter with email/password auth, teams and member roles, activity log, and Stripe checkout/customer-portal subscriptions on Postgres via Drizzle.
Invoice builder that renders invoices to PDF with Puppeteer, exports JSON/CSV/XML, saves drafts in the browser and emails invoices via Nodemailer.
Self-hostable scheduling app with booking links, availability rules, Google Calendar sync, SMTP booking notifications and optional Stripe paid bookings on Postgres via Prisma.
Full-stack RealWorld Conduit built on Next.js with an Apollo GraphQL API (Nexus) and Prisma, covering articles, comments, follows and JWT auth.
Full-stack RealWorld Conduit on the Next.js App Router with server actions, NextAuth credentials auth and Prisma on Vercel Postgres.
Fashion e-commerce storefront with product listing, filtering, product pages, cart and checkout UI backed by Redux and static/mock product data; no real backend, auth or payments.
Appointment booking app where users list services and others book time slots, with NextAuth login, Prisma/MongoDB storage, map locations and Cloudinary image uploads.
Full-stack template whose FastAPI backend provides JWT auth, user management with password-recovery emails, and CRUD for items on PostgreSQL via SQLModel, with Sentry hooks.
FastAPI blog backend (posts, users, JWT auth) on PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy with OpenTelemetry tracing to Jaeger and a separate Next.js frontend.
Async to-do list API with fastapi-users authentication (registration, verification and password-reset emails) and PostgreSQL via async SQLAlchemy.
E-commerce API with products, variants and media, OTP/JWT account auth, SMTP emails and local product-image uploads on PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy.
Maintained copy of the classic FastAPI RealWorld Conduit API (articles, comments, profiles, JWT auth) using raw SQL via aiosql/asyncpg, instrumented with ddtrace.
To-do application API in hexagonal architecture with user registration, JWT auth and todo CRUD on PostgreSQL via `databases`.
RealWorld Conduit API (articles, comments, profiles, JWT auth) on FastAPI adapted to MySQL via aiomysql.
Small Django to-do list web app with user accounts, multiple lists and items, plus a Django REST Framework API.
Recipe-sharing backend: users publish recipes with images, follow authors, favorite recipes and download a shopping list; React frontend in a sibling dir.
Server-rendered Django e-commerce shop with product catalog and categories, product images, cart and order checkout form (no payment gateway).
Multi-site self-hosted job board where companies post jobs, with paid listings via Stripe, Mailchimp/email notifications and tweeting of new jobs.
RealWorld Conduit backend implemented with Django Ninja: articles, comments, tags, favorites, follows and JWT auth on SQLite/PostgreSQL.
RealWorld Conduit backend on Django REST Framework with SimpleJWT auth, taggit tags, filtering and Swagger docs on PostgreSQL.
Meetup-style event management system where users create groups and events, RSVP and comment, with Cloudinary image storage and a DRF API.
Official Go + Gin RealWorld Conduit backend with GORM (SQLite), JWT auth, articles, comments, tags and follows.
Clean-architecture RealWorld Conduit implementation in Go with Gin handlers, JWT auth and in-memory repositories behind interfaces.
RealWorld Conduit backend on Gin and go-pg (PostgreSQL) with Redis caching/rate limiting and OpenTelemetry tracing via Uptrace.
Hexagonal RealWorld Conduit backend in Go with Gin HTTP and gRPC transports and swappable PostgreSQL (Bun) or MongoDB repositories.
RealWorld Conduit backend API built with Echo and GORM (SQLite) with JWT auth and Swagger docs.
RealWorld Conduit backend API built with Fiber v2 and GORM (SQLite), JWT middleware and Swagger docs.
Small clean-architecture article service in Go: Echo REST handlers for listing, fetching, storing and deleting articles with authors on MySQL.
URL shortener with a web UI, JSON API and terminal client; stores links in PostgreSQL via GORM, caches lookups in Redis and protects admin endpoints with OpenID Connect.
Discord music bot that plays YouTube/SoundCloud audio in voice channels with queue, playlist, lyrics and i18n slash commands.
Discord bot with slash/context commands, event handlers, scheduled jobs, sharding cluster manager and a small Express master API.
Bot that bridges Telegram groups and Discord channels, relaying messages, edits, deletions and media both ways with SQLite message mapping.
Telegram bot that protects groups from spammers with captchas, restrictions and per-chat settings stored in MongoDB, plus a small Koa API and Stripe subscription.
Service that scrapes free game offers (Steam, Epic, GOG, etc.) with Playwright on a schedule, stores them in SQLite and pushes them via Telegram, Discord and RSS feeds.
Command-line task, note and event manager with boards, priorities and due dates, storing data locally or in Firebase Firestore.
Slack Bolt app that lets workspace members post and reply anonymously ('bamboo forest') to a channel via modals and shortcuts.
Official Todoist command-line client to list, add, complete and organize tasks and projects via the Todoist API with OAuth login stored in the OS keyring.
Offline-first personal expense tracker (bare React Native CLI) with categories, analytics charts and debt tracking; data is stored on-device in WatermelonDB with no server.
Local-first collaborative grocery shopping list built with Expo Router; lists are stored in TinyBase over expo-sqlite and synced via a small Cloudflare Workers WebSocket server, with Clerk sign-in.

Ignite-based Expo habit tracker with habit creation, streak/progress charts and calendar views; state is persisted locally via MobX-State-Tree + AsyncStorage (no real DB, notifications or crash reporting wired up).
Small Expo todo app organized with Feature-Sliced Design, using Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query against a simple REST todos API.
Real-time multi-user chat rooms app built with Expo Router, using Clerk (incl. passkeys) for auth and Appwrite for the message database/realtime.
Bare React Native workout logging app with AI-based workout scoring, gamification and an offline demo mode; backed by Supabase with Adapty subscriptions and Firebase Analytics.
Privacy-focused caller ID app: stores alternate contacts locally (MMKV via Zustand) and identifies unknown callers with custom native modules, Material 3 UI and biometric lock.
Open-source Bumble-style dating app built with Expo Router: swipe deck, matches and chat screens, with Appwrite as backend.
Material You task manager with categories, calendar and statistics views, stored locally in Isar with scheduled local-notification reminders.
Material You weather app using the Open-Meteo API with multiple locations, maps, home-screen widgets, background refresh and weather notifications; data cached in Isar and via an HTTP cache.
Expense tracking app built with clean architecture/MVVM (Provider + get_it), storing entries in Hive and showing spending insights charts, with local reminder notifications.
Movie browser for TMDB now-playing listings and search with infinite scrolling and movie details, built with Riverpod, Dio, Freezed and GoRouter.
Habit tracker with daily routines, streaks, timers and statistics; data stored in Hive and reminders via local notifications.

Movie ticket booking app (browse films, showtimes, cinemas on a map, seat selection) built with BLoC/clean architecture, Retrofit REST client, Firebase Auth + Google Sign-In and Firestore, plus sqflite local storage.
eCommerce shop app from the Flutter Foundations course (products, cart, checkout, orders, reviews) using Riverpod and GoRouter, with fake in-memory auth/repositories and a Sembast local cart.
One-to-one chat app built on Firebase: Google sign-in, Firestore messages, Firebase Storage image sharing and FCM push notifications.

Hastebin-style pastebin with a Fastify 5 + TypeBox backend and Vite frontend; documents are stored as files on disk by default (FileDocumentStore), with an optional Redis key-value store. No user accounts or login.

Koa + socket.io backend (with Vue frontend) for running in-person Werewolf/Mafia games: rooms, players, roles, votes and night actions; all game state lives in an in-memory static Room map and is lost on restart. Players are identified only by a room number + player-id header; no accounts.

Venmo-style payment app (users, bank accounts, transactions, likes, comments, notifications) with an Express + TypeScript REST/GraphQL backend in backend/ and a React frontend. All data lives in a lowdb JSON file (data/database.json, seeded by faker scripts) rather than a real database; local login uses passport-local sessions, with optional Auth0/Okta/Cognito/Google modes.

Next.js 14 chat interface for local Ollama models with multiple conversations, model pulling and username settings. Chats and user preferences are persisted only in browser localStorage via a zustand persist store; there is no login and no database.

Next.js + Tailwind blogging app with posts, authors, tags, pagination and RSS. All content lives as MDX/JSON files in data/ compiled by Contentlayer at build time; there are no user accounts and no database (comments/newsletter delegated to third-party providers).

Next.js calendar app (day/week/month/year/agenda views, drag-and-drop, add/edit/delete events, per-user filtering). Events and users come from hardcoded mock arrays (src/features/calendar/mocks.ts) held in React context state; nothing is persisted and there is no login.

Next.js quiz platform for creating, taking and tracking quizzes with results, leaderboard, achievements and notifications. All data is hardcoded in lib/data.ts and kept in zustand stores persisted to localStorage; login/register is a fake client-side check against the in-memory users array (plaintext passwords), so there is no real auth and no database.

Self-hosted markdown note-taking app (FastAPI backend in server/, Vue client) that stores every note as a .md file in a flat folder, with a Whoosh full-text index and no database. Login is a single username/password (optional TOTP) taken from env vars; there are no user accounts or registration.

Reminder-list web app built with FastAPI, Jinja and HTMX, plus a JSON API and Playwright tests. Lists and items live in a TinyDB JSON file (reminder_db.json), and the users are a hardcoded username/password map in config.json behind a JWT cookie login, so there is no real database and no user registration.

IoT device-management dashboard (devices, sales events, telemetry events) built with FastAPI, HTMX/fasthx, Jinja and DaisyUI. Data is stored in MongoDB through motor/motorhead, and there is no authentication of any kind.

Self-hostable personal site and blog served by FastAPI, Jinja and HTMX, with RSS/Atom feeds, SEO and llms.txt. All content comes from markdown files with front matter plus a site.yaml under content/, reloaded on change. There is no database, no admin UI and no authentication.

Django quiz app where visitors take quizzes with free-text and multiple-choice questions that are graded server-side. Quizzes are stored in PostgreSQL through the Django ORM. There are no player accounts: only the Django admin, for staff authoring quizzes. Includes Azure Bicep infra for azd deployment.

Django restaurant-review site where anyone can add restaurants and post star-rated reviews anonymously. Data is stored in PostgreSQL through the ORM, with a Redis cache for pages and sessions. There are no user accounts (only the stock Django admin), and it ships Azure Bicep infra.

Anonymous pastebin for code and text with syntax highlighting, expiring snippets, diffs and a REST-ish API. Snippets are stored through the Django ORM (SQLite by default, Postgres via dj-database-url). There is no django.contrib.auth at all: per-visitor history is tracked only in the session.

Self-hosted micro feed for posting text snippets, images and files across devices, with a chi HTTP API, websockets and an embedded React UI; feeds, items and per-feed config.json are stored as plain files in a data directory. Access is via per-feed secret/PIN tokens, no user accounts.

Flat-file blogging engine: Gin server renders posts from markdown files with YAML front matter, watches the directory for changes and keeps parsed pages in memory; also serves RSS. No database and no admin/user login.

Privacy-respecting Pictionary/skribbl.io clone with a net/http server, websocket game protocol and server-rendered templates; lobbies, players and scores are kept only in an in-memory lobby registry and word lists are bundled text files. Players join anonymously with no accounts.
RealWorld (Medium-clone) backend in Spring Boot with REST and GraphQL (Netflix DGS) APIs, JWT auth and MyBatis over SQLite.
Canonical Spring Boot pet clinic web app (Thymeleaf MVC) for owners, pets, vets and visits, backed by JPA on H2/MySQL/PostgreSQL.
Personal finance microservices app (accounts, statistics, notifications) built with Spring Cloud (Eureka, Zuul, Config, OAuth2) and MongoDB.
Domain-driven modular-monolith e-shop (catalog, cart, ordering, delivery, dispatching, warehouse, billing) with Spring Boot, JDBC and Thymeleaf; billing is internal, no real payment provider.
Microservices version of Spring PetClinic with config server, Eureka discovery, gateway, Spring Boot Admin, Prometheus/Grafana/Zipkin and a Spring AI chatbot service.
Self-hosted SQL-based BI server for building dashboards and reports; Spring Boot + JDBC backend with SQLite metadata store and a React web app.
RealWorld Conduit API implemented with Quarkus, RESTEasy, Hibernate ORM Panache and JWT (java-jwt + jBCrypt), on H2/PostgreSQL.
Web dashboard to monitor and control multiple Bambu Lab 3D printers over MQTT/FTP, built with Quarkus, Vaadin and Apache Camel.
Small Spring Boot REST API that shortens URLs and redirects to the original, using JPA on H2/PostgreSQL with Swagger docs and a Heroku Procfile.
Email newsletter service from the book 'Zero To Production in Rust': subscriptions with confirmation emails, admin login, idempotent issue delivery via a Postgres-backed worker.
Minimal pastebin with syntax highlighting, expiring/burn-after-read and optionally encrypted pastes, served by axum with a SQLite store.
LRCLIB: public API and server for synchronized song lyrics, using axum, SQLite (r2d2) and a Tantivy full-text search index with background indexing.
Full-stack RealWorld Conduit implementation with an axum + sqlx (PostgreSQL) backend and a Yew WebAssembly frontend in a Cargo workspace.
Self-hosted, minimal URL shortener with an actix-web backend, SQLite storage, password-protected admin UI and Docker deployment.
Public REST API for aircraft, airline and flight-route lookups, built with axum, PostgreSQL (sqlx) and Redis caching/rate limiting, plus a scraper for missing data.
CLI tool that serves files and directories over HTTP with uploads, archive downloads, WebDAV, QR codes, TLS and basic auth, built on actix-web.
Incomplete, idiomatic Redis server and client (GET/SET/PUBLISH/SUBSCRIBE) built with Tokio, with optional OpenTelemetry tracing.
Rust GraphQL (Juniper) server on actix-web with Diesel/PostgreSQL, session/identity auth and JWT for user registration and login.
ripgrep (rg): a line-oriented recursive regex search CLI that respects .gitignore, split into grep-* and ignore crates.
bat: a cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting, git integration and paging.
fd: a simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to find, with parallel directory traversal and gitignore support.
Nushell: a cross-platform shell and scripting language with structured data pipelines, a plugin system, an LSP and a Polars dataframe plugin.
Taskwarrior: command-line todo list manager; C++ CLI over the Rust TaskChampion storage/sync library (SQLite replica) linked via Corrosion and cxx.
Timewarrior: command-line time tracking and reporting tool storing intervals in plain-text data files, with Taskwarrior hook integration.
btop++: terminal resource monitor showing CPU, memory, disks, network, processes and GPUs, with themes and mouse support.
Polybar: customizable status bar for X11 window managers with modules for i3/bspwm, ALSA/PulseAudio, MPD, network, battery and GitHub notifications.
Complete CRUD REST service (UserService) built with Oat++, using SQLite via oatpp-sqlite, Swagger UI docs and a Dockerfile.
TLGS: search engine for the Gemini protocol with a C++20 Drogon server, an async crawler/indexer and a PostgreSQL-backed index.
Streaming TTS server and CLI based on Piper (ONNX Runtime, optional RK3588 NPU), exposing HTTP/WebSocket APIs via Drogon with Opus/OGG encoding.
Rooms-based browser chat server (with file sharing between peers) built on Oat++ async WebSockets with OpenSSL/LibreSSL TLS.
Dynolog: Linux telemetry daemon collecting CPU/GPU/perf metrics, exporting to Prometheus/OTLP and triggering on-demand PyTorch/GPU traces via RPC.
